jobs.description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled senior technician/automechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,400 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

• 
Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems

• 
Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

• 
Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors

• 
Servicing and repairing AC pumps and climate systems

• 
Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

• 
Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

• 
Are a trained passenger car mechanic or have an equivalent technical background

• 
Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

• 
Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

• 
Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

• 
Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

• 
Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

• 
To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

• 
An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

• 
Ongoing training and good development opportunities

• 
A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

• 
Attractive terms of employment

• 
A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a passion for hospitality, and the ability to deliver service that makes guests feel special? We are looking for new staff to join our team at MaDaMi.

About the Role
You will be the face of the restaurant, greeting guests, guiding them through the menu, serving food and drinks, and ensuring every detail of the dining experience is handled with care. We aim to deliver high-quality service with warmth, precision, and personality. Support kitchen staff with simple tasks when needed. Help with general cleaning to ensure a safe, clean, and organized environment.

What We Offer

• 
A dynamic workplace where quality and service come first.

• 
Training in high-level hospitality and guest service.

• 
A supportive and professional team environment.

• 
Staff meals during shifts.

• 
Opportunities for professional growth.

What We Expect From You

• 
A natural sense of responsibility and awareness.

• 
Excellent communication skills and a friendly, confident presence.

• 
Attention to detail and high standards for quality.

• 
Ability to balance professionalism with a relaxed, approachable style.

• 
Previous experience in hospitality is a plus, but the right mindset is more important.

• 
Fluent in English

If you are motivated, and eager to deliver memorable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Kok med erfaring i autentisk indisk køkken søges til Jalsa Indisk Restaurant Aalborg / Jalsa Indian Restaurant Aalborg is looking for an experienced chef specializing in authentic Indian cuisine
jobs.description:
For international candidates, the English version follows below the Danish version.

Jalsa Indisk Restaurant Aalborg søger en dygtig og erfaren kok til vores etablerede køkkenteam.

Vores restaurant i Aalborg har opbygget en stærk position og et godt omdømme blandt vores gæster, og vi oplever fortsat stor efterspørgsel. Tilberedning og præsentation af autentiske indiske retter

• 
Tilberedning af curryretter, tandoorretter, naan og andre traditionelle indiske specialiteter

Arbejde med traditionelle indiske krydderier, marinader, saucer og tilberedningsteknikker

Forberedelse og produktion til den daglige restaurantdrift

Sikring af ensartet kvalitet, smag og præsentation

Overholdelse af regler og procedurer vedrørende hygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

• 
Samarbejde med køkkenchef, ledelse og øvrige medarbejdere

• 
Bidrage til oplæring af nye medarbejdere samt udvikling og kvalitetssikring af vores retter

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har dokumenteret professionel erfaring som kok

• 
Har solid erfaring med autentisk indisk madlavning

• 
Har erfaring med tandoorovn og traditionelle indiske curryretter

• 
Har godt kendskab til indiske krydderier, marinader og traditionelle tilberedningsmetoder

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt og effektivt i et travlt restaurantkøkken

Er kvalitetsbevidst, stabil, ansvarsfuld og samarbejdsvillig

Er fleksibel med hensyn til arbejdstider og kan arbejde både hverdage, aftener og weekender

Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Kendskab til dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Fast fuldtidsansættelse, 37 timer om ugen

En arbejdsplads i en etableret og populær restaurant i centrum af Aalborg

• 
Et professionelt og internationalt arbejdsmiljø

• 
Et erfarent team med fokus på kvalitet og autentisk indisk mad

• 
Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og ansvar

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer og i overensstemmelse med gældende danske regler

• 
Ordentlige ansættelses- og arbejdsforhold

Arbejdssted

Jalsa Indisk Restaurant Aalborg
Ved Stranden 5, st. tv.
9000 Aalborg

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning samt relevante oplysninger om din erhvervserfaring til info@jalsa.dk.

Skriv venligst “Ansøgning – Kok Aalborg” i emnefeltet.

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

English

Jalsa Indian Restaurant Aalborg is looking for an experienced chef specializing in authentic Indian cuisine

Jalsa Indian Restaurant Aalborg is looking for a skilled and experienced chef to join our established kitchen team.

Jalsa is a well-established Indian restaurant with locations in both Aalborg and Randers. Our Aalborg restaurant has built a strong position and a good reputation among our guests, and we continue to experience high demand. We are therefore looking to strengthen our kitchen team with another experienced chef who has solid professional experience in authentic Indian cuisine.

Responsibilities

As a chef, you will be an important part of the daily kitchen operation. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Preparing and presenting authentic Indian dishes

• 
Preparing curries, tandoor dishes, naan and other traditional Indian specialties

• 
Working with traditional Indian spices, marinades, sauces and cooking techniques

• 
Preparation and production for the daily restaurant operation

• 
Ensuring consistent quality, taste and presentation

• 
Following procedures and regulations regarding hygiene and food safety

• 
Stock management and control of ingredients

• 
Cooperating with the head chef, management and other team members

• 
Assisting with training new kitchen employees and contributing to the development and quality control of our dishes

We expect that you

• 
Have documented professional experience as a chef

• 
Have solid experience with authentic Indian cuisine

• 
Have experience working with a tandoor oven and traditional Indian curry dishes

• 
Have good knowledge of Indian spices, marinades and traditional cooking techniques

• 
Are able to work independently and efficiently in a busy restaurant kitchen

• 
Are quality-conscious, reliable, responsible and cooperative

• 
Are able to stay organized and focused during busy periods

• 
Are flexible regarding working hours and able to work weekdays, evenings and weekends

• 
Are able to communicate in English. Knowledge of Danish is an advantage but not a requirement

We offer

• 
Permanent full-time employment, 37 hours per week

• 
A position in an established and popular restaurant in central Aalborg

• 
A professional and international working environment

• 
An experienced team with a strong focus on quality and authentic Indian cuisine

• 
Good opportunities for professional development and responsibility

• 
Salary based on qualifications and in accordance with applicable Danish rules

• 
Proper employment and working conditions

Workplace

Jalsa Indian Restaurant Aalborg
Ved Stranden 5, ground floor, left
9000 Aalborg
Denmark

How to apply

Please send your CV, a short application and relevant information about your professional experience to info@jalsa.dk.

Please write “Application – Chef Aalborg” in the subject line.

The position is to be filled as soon as possible.

ENGLISH:

Malerfirmaet DMR is a well-established company located on Søborg Hovedgade in Dyssegård. Over the years, we have provided professional painting services to a wide range of customers. In addition to painting, we also offer carpentry and flooring services.

We are currently looking for 1–2 experienced colleagues to join our carpentry team and help us handle our growing portfolio of projects.

If you have experience as a carpenter and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with a positive and friendly atmosphere.

About the job

At Malerfirmaet DMR, you will work on a variety of carpentry tasks, including building floor structures, installing plasterboard/drywall, constructing light timber structures, and other related carpentry work.

You will normally work together with a colleague, so there will usually be two of you assigned to each project. For smaller jobs, however, you should be comfortable working independently.

As a team, you will have access to a company vehicle equipped with the necessary machinery and tools.

We expect you to:

1. Have at least 1 year of experience working as a carpenter

2. Hold a valid Category B driving licence

3. Be reliable, responsible and able to communicate in English or Danish

4. Take pride in completing your work to a high standard and leaving the work area clean and tidy

We offer:

1. Attractive salary

2. Working hours between 07:00 and 15:00

3. Supportive and experienced colleagues you can exchange knowledge with

4. Exciting and varied carpentry projects

Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions? You are very welcome to contact us by email at info@dmrmalerarbejde.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Passionate Chef for dynamic kitchen at OURI
jobs.description:
OURI is a highly regarded Korean restaurant located in the heart of Copenhagen at Sankt Peders Stræde 24a, known for its authentic flavors and cozy atmosphere. We are busy and are looking for a dedicated Chef to join our kitchen team on a full-time basis.

Your daily tasks include:

• 
Preparation, cooking, and presentation of dishes in accordance with our quality standards.

• 
Cooperation with kitchen staff to ensure smooth daily operations.

• 
Ordering and receiving goods, and managing kitchen inventory.

• 
Ensuring high standards of food safety, hygiene, and overall kitchen workflow.

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Is a trained chef or has solid professional experience in the restaurant or catering industry.

• 
Is happy and smiling in your approach to other people, guests as well as colleagues, even when it is really busy.

• 
Masters English. Several different nationalities work in our kitchen and restaurant team.

Workplace: Sankt Peders Stræde 24a, 1453 Copenhagen K, Denmark.

How to Apply: Please send your CV and application to welcome@ouri.dk. (If you have not heard from us within 14 days, it is because the job has been filled.)

• Offshore position in Esbjerg, Denmark 
• 2/3
• 12 hours shift
• Day shift and night shift will be rotated on every alternate offshore trip
• Participation in required courses must be expected during home period
• Start date: ASAP
Scope of Work

• Operate the facilities on a day-to-day basis
• Ensure operations are executed within operating scope and in accordance with company rules and procedures  
• Perform the first degree of maintenance  
• Act as Area Authority, opening at location permit to work (final checks, TBT, Hazard identification, permit to work compliance etc.)    
• Conduct the daily rounds to monitor the facilities, log data, check integrity threats, check safe operation of third parties)

• Educational background as process technician, skilled craftsman or similar with craftsman diploma
• 5 years of experience with process, preferably from oil and gas industry
• Preferably former work experience as Production Operator
• Good analytical skills, structured and able to follow instructions closely
• Must be able to communicate effectively in English. Danish is an advantage.
• Clear focus on HSE
Welcome to Semco Maritime

Please submit your application as soon as possible if you would like to join our great team. Candidates will be invited for interviews on an ongoing basis.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• 
A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

• 
Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

• 
Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

• 
The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

• 
Good written and spoken English. 

• 
A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

• 
Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

• 
Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

• 
Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

• 
Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

• 
International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

• 
Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

• 
Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

• 
Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

• 
Two letters of recommendation. 

• 
A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

• 
The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

• 
Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos

In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor

In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos

Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables

•

Required skills and experience

The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.

Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance

Strong organizational, planning and time management skills

Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor

Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions

Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams

At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor

Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates

• 
Full professional proficiency in English

 Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime.

JP Dynasty ApS is Hiring: Group Kitchen Manager

JP Dynasty ApS is a Copenhagen-based Asian restaurant group operating multiple brands and locations.

As our group continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Group Kitchen Manager / Multi-Unit Kitchen Manager to oversee kitchen operations across several locations.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Oversee daily kitchen operations across multiple restaurant locations

• 
Conduct regular kitchen inspections to ensure consistent food quality, speed, hygiene, and operational standards

• 
Develop, improve, and implement kitchen SOPs

• 
Manage, train, and support Kitchen Managers and kitchen teams

• 
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and HACCP requirements

• 
Monitor and control food costs, labour costs, waste, and kitchen efficiency

• 
Supervise inventory, ordering, stock counts, FIFO, and raw material usage

• 
Use inventory and management systems to identify operational and cost issues

• 
Coordinate closely with central kitchen, purchasing, restaurant managers, and the office team

• 
Manage implementation of new dishes from testing and standardisation to launch across all locations

• 
Adjust production levels, preparation, and staffing based on sales and operational needs

• 
Handle urgent operational issues and develop long-term solutions

• 
Support new restaurant openings, including kitchen setup, workflows, and staff training

• 
Provide regular reports to management on kitchen performance, issues, and improvement plans
